summary: Full E2E for IronMind 360 MVP passed. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases green (auth register/login/me, dashboard shape+score, habits upsert PUT/GET + score persistence, settings GET/PUT goals, intervals sync=400 without key, workouts empty+connected=false, coach chat via Claude Sonnet 5 returning real reply, coach history, nutrition analyze via gpt-5.4 vision on a real JPEG food photo returning title/calories/macros/coach_note, /api/nutrition list+totals, /api/files/{path} serves image with image/* content-type, DELETE meal soft-delete verified via re-GET). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login → dashboard (discipline score 55) → habit toggles (meditate/read/cold) + water +/- responsive → Coach tab AI reply received in Goggins style → Nutrição tab loads → Treinos shows empty-state with 'Conectar intervals.icu' CTA (correct since demo user has no key) → back to Comando → Settings screen opens (name, API key, athlete_id, 4 goal inputs). No red screen. Only cosmetic RN-web warnings (fonts DMSans failing to decode fall back gracefully; 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' style prop deprecation warnings from RN web).

issues: RN-web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only.
Custom DMSans font files fail to decode on web ('OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion'); fallback fonts render fine but consider fixing font asset paths for web preview.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate custom font asset serving on web preview - DMSans .ttf files return HTML/text and fail decode; fonts currently fall back but the console is noisy.
(Optional) Replace deprecated RN-web style props: rename shadow* -> boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style prop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is ~670 lines - still manageable but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting routers per domain (auth/nutrition/coach/habits) if it grows.
compute_discipline correctly capped at 100; ObjectId excluded from responses; env vars used with hard-fail on missing MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET (good).
nutrition_list assigns `out = []` then overwrites with `meals` – dead assignment, harmless.
gather_context: on days with zero registered activities but recorded habits, avg_mood/sleep computed only over `habits` length; safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, 4 tabs nav, habits, coach chat, settings)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_user_<ts>@ironmind.app created by register test (kept, harmless). One test meal was created and soft-deleted during nutrition test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Demo user demo@ironmind.app / Goggins@43 auto-seeded on startup. Nutrition test uses a real food JPEG downloaded from Unsplash (fallback to Pillow-generated JPEG). AI endpoints (coach + vision) work through EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; both took <15s per call.
